source_title: Care of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1: a clinical practice resource of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
claim_text: The incidence of pheochromocytoma in NF1 is estimated at 0.1-5.7% of patients, with 22% asymptomatic; incidence in autopsy series is higher (3.3-13.0%).
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Genet Med 2018;20:671-682; not in PMC). Statement made by the ACMG adult NF1 practice resource citing ref 42 Walther 1999 PMID 10524872. Secondary citation: not independent of the cited primary work; primary paper should be read for strength grading.
independence_flags: secondary citation via guideline PMID 30006586 of ref 42
